key_insight: GIFT selectively applies teacher guidance by measuring its gradient alignment with reinforcement learning, reducing optimization conflict while retaining complementary reasoning signals.
engineering_relevance: For reasoning-model training, GIFT offers a principled way to allocate distillation updates without letting imitation undermine the outcome-based RL objective.
method: Decompose token-level distillation gradients into components parallel and orthogonal to the RL gradient.
Rank guidance using parallel alignment for safety and orthogonal contribution for directional value.
Progressively shrink distillation coverage, retaining selected updates at full strength before transitioning to pure RL.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent improvements over strong baselines on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks across multiple model scales, with relative gains up to 9.5% on difficult math tasks.
watch_item: Token-level gradient analysis may add training overhead; the abstract does not quantify its computational cost.
paper_title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
